 Watch the song 'Bande Mein Dum Hai' from Hindi web series 'Dhindora 2' starring Bhuvan Bam, Sanjeeda Shaikh, Kabir Duhan Singh and Kanwaljit Singh. 'Bande Mein Dum Hai' is sung by Aaman Trikha and Dee MC, with music composed by Javed-Mohsin. Lyrics of 'Dhindora 2' song 'Bande Mein Dum Hai' are written by Danish Sabri and Dee MC. The original soundtrack and theme are also written and composed by Javed-Mohsin. 'Dhindora 2' is directed by Sneha Shetty Kohli and produced by Rohit Raj and Bhuvan Bam.
